registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control and mode register. Writing ENABLE/ARM begins normal operation when operating-point inputs are valid. SOFT_RESET requests synchronous reinitialization. DIAGNOSTIC_BYPASS allows non-nominal diagnostic operation if supported by software policy. FALLBACK_SELECT selects fallback source behavior.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: 1 enables request/response transaction management and actuator command generation.

fields.name: SOFT_RESET
fields.description: 1 requests a synchronous software reset-equivalent clear of outstanding transaction state, sticky faults, and request output valid.

fields.name: ARM
fields.description: 1 arms the controller to issue a request when ENABLE is asserted and the operating envelope is valid.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_BYPASS
fields.description: 1 permits diagnostic bypass behavior if implemented; normal safety checks remain authoritative unless explicitly overridden by design policy.

fields.name: FALLBACK_SELECT
fields.description: Selects fallback value source. 0 uses configured safe_actuator_value; 1 may select hold-last-safe behavior when combined with FALLBACK_HOLD_REVERT.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved, read as zero.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live controller status and fault summary.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: 1 indicates the controller is active in a transaction or fallback handling path.

fields.name: REQ_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: 1 indicates a request has been issued and not yet completed by handshake or abort path.

fields.name: RSP_VALID_SEEN
fields.description: 1 indicates at least one response-valid event has been observed during the current transaction window.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: 1 indicates request or response timeout expiration.

fields.name: STALE
fields.description: 1 indicates stale or late response rejection.

fields.name: CLAMPED
fields.description: 1 indicates actuator command was clamped to configured limits.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: 1 indicates fallback command selection is active.

fields.name: ENVELOPE_ERROR
fields.description: 1 indicates operating point rejected for violating envelope constraints, including velocity envelope.

registers.name: VEHICLE_META
registers.description: Compact vehicle/geometry metadata tag used to build the 64-bit request packet. This is an opaque identifier summary, not bulk geometry storage.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_PRESENT
fields.description: 1 indicates geometry metadata is present and valid in the software/host context.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_ID
fields.description: Lower nibble of geometry identifier summary.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_TYPE
fields.description: Upper bits of the geometry type summary. Full geometry_type input exists at the top level; this register reflects the compact CSR-visible tag.

registers.name: VEHICLE_META_ID
registers.description: Additional metadata byte for geometry identity and checksum packing.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_ID_EXT
fields.description: Extended geometry identifier bits, if software uses more than four bits for the metadata tag.

fields.name: CHECKSUM_HI
fields.description: Upper nibble of metadata checksum.

fields.name: CHECKSUM_LO
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of the 16-bit checksum tag.

registers.name: FLOW_COND_LO
registers.description: Velocity setpoint low byte. Fixed-point/integer representation; the controller enforces the 20 to 55 m/s operating envelope using the full 16-bit velocity_setpoint input.

fields.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of velocity setpoint fixed-point/integer value.

fields.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of velocity setpoint fixed-point/integer value.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of actuator minimum bound.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of actuator minimum bound.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of actuator maximum bound.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of actuator maximum bound.

registers.name: LIMITS_RATE_LO
registers.description: Rate limit low byte. Interpreted as fixed-point/integer limit on command step magnitude or update rate policy, as implemented by RTL.

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of rate limit.

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of rate limit.

fields.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of request timeout cycle count.

fields.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of request timeout cycle count.

fields.name: STALE_TIMEOUT_CYCLES_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of stale timeout cycle count.

fields.name: STALE_TIMEOUT_CYCLES_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of stale timeout cycle count.

fields.name: REQUEST_SEQ
fields.description: Sequence number included in outbound request packet.

fields.name: RESPONSE_SEQ
fields.description: Sequence number expected from inbound response packet.

fields.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_SEQ
fields.description: Most recent accepted response sequence number for auditability.

registers.name: RESULT_DRAG_LO
registers.description: Lower byte of compact drag summary metric captured from accepted response path.

fields.name: DRAG_METRIC_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of drag metric.

registers.name: RESULT_DRAG_HI
registers.description: Upper byte of compact drag summary metric.

fields.name: DRAG_METRIC_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of drag metric.

registers.name: RESULT_LIFT_LO
registers.description: Lower byte of compact lift summary metric captured from accepted response path.

fields.name: LIFT_METRIC_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of lift metric.

registers.name: RESULT_LIFT_HI
registers.description: Upper byte of compact lift summary metric.

fields.name: LIFT_METRIC_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of lift metric.

registers.name: RESULT_STATUS
registers.description: Response status summary from the accepted response path.

fields.name: RESPONSE_STATUS
fields.description: Compact response status code captured from inbound model response and validation logic.

registers.name: FALLBACK_LO
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator value low byte.

fields.name: SAFE_ACTUATOR_VALUE_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of deterministic safe actuator value.

registers.name: FALLBACK_HI
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator value high byte and fallback policy control.

fields.name: SAFE_ACTUATOR_VALUE_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of deterministic safe actuator value.

fields.name: FALLBACK_HOLD_REVERT
fields.description: 0 forces configured safe_actuator_value during fallback; 1 allows hold-last-safe/revert behavior when supported.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved, read as zero.

fields.name: DESIGN_VERSION_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of design version identifier.

fields.name: DESIGN_VERSION_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of design version identifier.

fields.name: MODEL_ID_TAG_7_0
fields.description: Low 8 bits of remote surrogate model identifier tag.

fields.name: MODEL_ID_TAG_15_8
fields.description: High 8 bits of remote surrogate model identifier tag.
